scope: Whole archived guide and pinned HTML; source interpretation, not human/server verification

1.original_instruction: Walk near Busy Looking Boy (prontera 248, 212) in Prontera to trigger a conversation. After picking up the books with him, you will be asked to send them to the Historian, Mr. Karlomoff in Juno . | Note: If you lose the books before you deliver them to Karlomoff, you can buy new ones from the Prontera library.
1.short_ru: Подойдите к Busy Looking Boy: prontera 248, 212, и возьмите книги для Karlomoff.
1.short_en: Approach Busy Looking Boy: prontera 248, 212, and take the books for Karlomoff.
1.full_ru: Подойдите к Busy Looking Boy в Prontera (prontera 248, 212), чтобы запустить разговор. Помогите собрать книги: он попросит отнести их историку Mr. Karlomoff в Juno. Примечание: если книги потеряны до передачи Karlomoff, новые можно купить в библиотеке Prontera.
1.full_en: Walk near Busy Looking Boy (prontera 248, 212) in Prontera to trigger a conversation. After picking up the books with him, you will be asked to send them to the Historian, Mr. Karlomoff in Juno . | Note: If you lose the books before you deliver them to Karlomoff, you can buy new ones from the Prontera library.

actions.condition: Books; replacement copies available at Prontera library if lost.

2.original_instruction: Travel to Juno and find the Historian, Karlomoff (yuno 311, 195). After a conversation about a traditional rhyme, you will be requested to deliver a report to a colleague in Morroc . You will receive a File Folder.
2.short_ru: Поговорите с Karlomoff: yuno 311, 195; получите File Folder.
2.short_en: Talk to Karlomoff: yuno 311, 195; receive File Folder.
2.full_ru: В Juno найдите историка Karlomoff (yuno 311, 195). После разговора о старинной рифмовке он попросит доставить отчёт коллеге в Morroc. Вы получите File Folder.
2.full_en: Travel to Juno and find the Historian, Karlomoff (yuno 311, 195). After a conversation about a traditional rhyme, you will be requested to deliver a report to a colleague in Morroc . You will receive a File Folder.

3.original_instruction: Proceed to a building at Morroc 5 o'clock (morocc 198, 63) to find the Historian, Rodafrian (morocc_in 45, 126). Tell her the rhyme you previously heard, but you will be asked to find someone in Mjolnir to verify it.
3.short_ru: Поговорите с Rodafrian: morocc_in 45, 126, в здании morocc 198, 63.
3.short_en: Talk to Rodafrian: morocc_in 45, 126, inside the building at morocc 198, 63.
3.full_ru: В Morroc идите к зданию в направлении 5 часов (morocc 198, 63). Найдите историка Rodafrian (morocc_in 45, 126) и перескажите услышанную рифмовку. Она попросит найти человека в Mjolnir, который её подтвердит.
3.full_en: Proceed to a building at Morroc 5 o'clock (morocc 198, 63) to find the Historian, Rodafrian (morocc_in 45, 126). Tell her the rhyme you previously heard, but you will be asked to find someone in Mjolnir to verify it.

4.original_instruction: Go to Mt. Mjolnir 1, two maps north of Geffen . Find the Historian, Mondo (mjolnir_01 135 168) and tell him the version you heard: | Note: If directly copying/pasting, be careful not to copy any spaces at the beginning or end of the phrase, as it will not work correctly. | The great serpent swallowed the sea. | The eagle of the rainbow swallowed the serpent. | Then the eagle built its nest. | A nest upon the swallowed sea. You will then be asked to find a child who sang the rhyme.
4.short_ru: У Mondo (mjolnir_01 135 168) введите строки рифмовки дословно, без лишних пробелов.
4.short_en: At Mondo (mjolnir_01 135 168), enter the rhyme lines exactly, without extra spaces.
4.full_ru: На Mt. Mjolnir 1, через две карты к северу от Geffen, найдите историка Mondo (mjolnir_01 135 168). Передайте услышанную версию по строкам: The great serpent swallowed the sea. | The eagle of the rainbow swallowed the serpent. | Then the eagle built its nest. | A nest upon the swallowed sea. При копировании не оставляйте пробелы в начале или конце строки: ответ не будет принят. Затем он попросит найти ребёнка, который пел эту рифмовку.
4.full_en: Go to Mt. Mjolnir 1, two maps north of Geffen . Find the Historian, Mondo (mjolnir_01 135 168) and tell him the version you heard: | Note: If directly copying/pasting, be careful not to copy any spaces at the beginning or end of the phrase, as it will not work correctly. | The great serpent swallowed the sea. | The eagle of the rainbow swallowed the serpent. | Then the eagle built its nest. | A nest upon the swallowed sea. You will then be asked to find a child who sang the rhyme.

actions.condition: Four lines in source order; no leading or trailing spaces.

options.text: The great serpent swallowed the sea.
The eagle of the rainbow swallowed the serpent.
Then the eagle built its nest.
A nest upon the swallowed sea.

5.original_instruction: Find the Absent-Minded Boy (mjolnir_01 313, 269) to hear the rhyme, but you will be interrupted by the Exhausted-Looking Woman (mjolnir_01 316, 268). Talk to the woman again and you will be requested to send herbs to Father Bamph in Prontera Church.
5.short_ru: Поговорите с Absent-Minded Boy, затем с Exhausted-Looking Woman: mjolnir_01 316, 268.
5.short_en: Talk to Absent-Minded Boy, then Exhausted-Looking Woman: mjolnir_01 316, 268.
5.full_ru: Найдите Absent-Minded Boy (mjolnir_01 313, 269), чтобы услышать рифмовку. Вас прервёт Exhausted-Looking Woman (mjolnir_01 316, 268). Снова поговорите с женщиной: она попросит отнести травы Father Bamph в церковь Prontera.
5.full_en: Find the Absent-Minded Boy (mjolnir_01 313, 269) to hear the rhyme, but you will be interrupted by the Exhausted-Looking Woman (mjolnir_01 316, 268). Talk to the woman again and you will be requested to send herbs to Father Bamph in Prontera Church.

6.original_instruction: Talk to Father Bamph (prt_church 185, 106) to learn about the Jormungand Curse. He will request you to inquire about the rhyme from the woman.
6.full_ru: Поговорите с Father Bamph (prt_church 185, 106), чтобы узнать о Jormungand Curse. Он попросит расспросить женщину о рифмовке.
6.full_en: Talk to Father Bamph (prt_church 185, 106) to learn about the Jormungand Curse. He will request you to inquire about the rhyme from the woman.

7.original_instruction: After learning about the difference of the rhymes from Bonnie Imbullea (Exhausted-Looking Woman, mjolnir_01 316, 268), return to Father Bamph to inform him about it.
7.short_ru: Расспросите Bonnie Imbullea: mjolnir_01 316, 268; доложите Father Bamph.
7.short_en: Question Bonnie Imbullea: mjolnir_01 316, 268; report to Father Bamph.
7.full_ru: У Bonnie Imbullea (Exhausted-Looking Woman, mjolnir_01 316, 268) узнайте о различии рифмовок, затем вернитесь с этими сведениями к Father Bamph.
7.full_en: After learning about the difference of the rhymes from Bonnie Imbullea (Exhausted-Looking Woman, mjolnir_01 316, 268), return to Father Bamph to inform him about it.

8.original_instruction: You will be asked to investigate the bodies of the dead princes in the mausoleum, through the secret path in the cabinet.
8.short_ru: Войдите в мавзолей через тайный проход в шкафу.
8.short_en: Enter the mausoleum through the secret passage in the cabinet.
8.full_ru: Вам поручат осмотреть тела умерших принцев в мавзолее. Войдите туда через тайный проход в шкафу.
8.full_en: You will be asked to investigate the bodies of the dead princes in the mausoleum, through the secret path in the cabinet.

9.original_instruction: Talk to Father Bamph first then examine the bodies from left to right and you find something suspicious. Answer "Poison!"
9.short_ru: Поговорите с Father Bamph, осмотрите тела слева направо и ответьте «Poison!».
9.short_en: Talk to Father Bamph, inspect the bodies left to right and answer “Poison!”.
9.full_ru: Сначала поговорите с Father Bamph, затем осмотрите тела слева направо. Обнаружив подозрительное, ответьте «Poison!».
9.full_en: Talk to Father Bamph first then examine the bodies from left to right and you find something suspicious. Answer "Poison!"

10.original_instruction: Return to the church and Father Bamph will ask to search for information in the Assassin Guild.
10.short_ru: Вернитесь к Father Bamph и получите поручение посетить Assassin Guild.
10.short_en: Return to Father Bamph and receive the Assassin Guild assignment.
10.full_ru: Вернитесь в церковь: Father Bamph попросит поискать сведения в Assassin Guild.
10.full_en: Return to the church and Father Bamph will ask to search for information in the Assassin Guild.

11.original_instruction: Proceed to the Assassin Guild and talk to the Assassin Guildsman (moc_fild16 201, 295). You will be asked to investigate at the Assassin's Secret Inn.
11.full_ru: В Assassin Guild поговорите с Assassin Guildsman (moc_fild16 201, 295). Он направит вас расследовать в Assassin's Secret Inn.
11.full_en: Proceed to the Assassin Guild and talk to the Assassin Guildsman (moc_fild16 201, 295). You will be asked to investigate at the Assassin's Secret Inn.

12.original_instruction: Enter the building at Morroc 8 o'clock (morocc 43, 108). Sharp-looking Kid in front of the building will not allow you to enter, but if you stand exactly on (47,108) and pay 1000 zeny then you can 'secretly' enter the building.
12.short_ru: Встаньте на (47,108) у здания morocc 43, 108 и заплатите 1000 zeny.
12.short_en: Stand at (47,108) by the building morocc 43, 108 and pay 1000 zeny.
12.full_ru: В Morroc идите к зданию в направлении 8 часов (morocc 43, 108). Sharp-looking Kid у входа не пропускает. Встаньте точно на (47,108) и заплатите 1000 zeny, чтобы тайно войти.
12.full_en: Enter the building at Morroc 8 o'clock (morocc 43, 108). Sharp-looking Kid in front of the building will not allow you to enter, but if you stand exactly on (47,108) and pay 1000 zeny then you can 'secretly' enter the building.

requirements.condition: Secret inn entrance at the exact trigger cell.

13.original_instruction: Follow the path to a bar room, then down the stairs. Find Marjana (que_job01 10, 16) in the north room to understand the method of using a Yellow Gemstone and Green Potion to identify poison. (Players will only have 4 minutes to remain in the room).
13.short_ru: Поговорите с Marjana: que_job01 10, 16; ограничение — 4 минуты.
13.short_en: Talk to Marjana: que_job01 10, 16; time limit is 4 minutes.
13.full_ru: Пройдите к бару и спуститесь по лестнице. В северной комнате найдите Marjana (que_job01 10, 16): она объяснит, как выявить яд с помощью Yellow Gemstone и Green Potion. В комнате можно оставаться только 4 минуты.
13.full_en: Follow the path to a bar room, then down the stairs. Find Marjana (que_job01 10, 16) in the north room to understand the method of using a Yellow Gemstone and Green Potion to identify poison. (Players will only have 4 minutes to remain in the room).

14.original_instruction: Return to Morroc (you must leave the building normally, using teleport or butterfly wing will cause problems!). You will reflect on what you now know, and have to decide on one of the following: A. Go back to Father Bamph first, or B. Inform Rodafrian. (This could violate the priest's edict and cause a quest complete without Exp) Option A : Go To Father Bamph First 1A. Go back to Father Bamph. He will ask you to verify if the princes are poisoned or not. 2A. Go to the mausoleum. Check on the 3rd prince. (Must have 1 Green Potion and 1 Yellow Gemstone). 3A. The serpent mark will vanish. Go back to the church office to discuss further. 4A. Father Bamph will ask you not to reveal the results to anyone yet due to the impact of the matter. He will ask you to bring some relief to Bonnie Imbullea. (Gain 1,600,000 base experience) 5A. Go back to Bonnie Imbullea (mjolnir_01 316, 268). Tell her that the exorcism is not her fault and good news will arrive soon. 6A. Go to Rodafrian. There will be 2 options here, i) Tell her about the curse: - She will be grateful and tell you about Western Region and Jormungand. Return to Father Bamph one last time to complete the quest. ii) Not telling her: - Rodafrian will be thankful of your help to solve her mystery. (Quest Finished) Option B : Go To Historian Rodafrian First (this is a dangerous option, as there is a failure path on this branch) 1B. Go to Rodafrian (morocc_in 45, 126) and tell her the last verse of the rhyme. Choose either tell her about the poisoned princes or not to tell. i) Tell her about the curse: - 1Bi. She will be grateful and tell you about the Western Region and Jormungand. 2Bi. Go back to Father Bamph. He will ask you to verify if the princes are poisoned or not. 3Bi. Go to the mausoleum. Check on the 3rd prince. (Must have 1 Green Potion and 1 Yellow Gemstone). 4Bi. The serpent mark will vanish. Go back to the church office to discuss further. 5Bi. Father Bamph will ask you not to reveal the results to anyone yet due to the impact of the matter. 6Bi. Talk to Father Biscuss (prt_church 184, 110) and he will thank you for your trouble. (Quest Finished, you receive EXP, and may now talk to Bonnie) | Note: If you speak to Bonnie prior to getting the EXP from Biscuss you will FAIL and get no EXP from this quest. This is due to breaking the Priest's edict of not telling anyone two times prior to them giving you clearance to do so. ii) Not telling her: - 1Bii. Rodafrian will be thankful for your help. 2Bii. Go back to Father Bamph. He will ask you to verify if the princes are poisoned or not. 3Bii. Go to the mausoleum. Check on the 3rd prince. (Must have 1 Green Potion and 1 Yellow Gemstone). 4Bii. The serpent mark will vanish. Talk to the Father Bamph that stands next to the corpses first, then go back to the church office to discuss further. 5Bii. Father Bamph will ask you not to reveal the results to anyone yet due to the impact of the matter. He will ask you to bring some relief to Bonnie Imbullea. (Gain 1,600,000 base experience) 6Bii. Go back to Bonnie Imbullea (mjolnir_01 316, 268). Tell her that the exorcism is not her fault and good news will arrive soon. (Quest Finished)
14.short_ru: Выйдите обычным путём; выберите маршрут A или B и соблюдайте порядок разговоров ради EXP.
14.short_en: Leave normally; choose route A or B and follow its conversation order to retain EXP.
14.full_ru: Вернитесь в Morroc, обязательно выйдя из здания обычным путём: teleport или butterfly wing могут вызвать проблемы. Выберите дальнейший путь: A — сначала вернуться к Father Bamph; B — сообщить Rodafrian. Второй путь может нарушить запрет священника и закончить квест без Exp.
14.full_en: Return to Morroc (you must leave the building normally, using teleport or butterfly wing will cause problems!). You will reflect on what you now know, and have to decide on one of the following: A. Go back to Father Bamph first, or B. Inform Rodafrian. (This could violate the priest's edict and cause a quest complete without Exp)
